plan.why: cold open on the end of the last chorus (GP 100 = the loudest fill bar)
title on the song's final chord (no drums) which rings and decays: the only stop in the song
H3 match cut: the band restarts (verse lead-in)
pain: the lightest verse (3 dB under the chorus, lighter bass; drums keep playing)
pain: the light verse again (12 bars of the quietest groove)
DROP on 21:1 = the fill bar GP 16 (+2.5 dB out of the light verse)
ADD-2 (inserted bar after 28: E4b camera glide)
AI section: chorus 1 thins into verse 2 from sb 37
the wait: the song's final chord ringing out (-20 -> -27 dB), the band has stopped
PAYOFF on the chorus-2 section start (the largest section step in the song, +1.4 dB)
social groove: jump into chorus 3 (peak fill GP 92 on sb 72 = the 8th-note fill bar)
break: the two lightest verse bars (no stop exists in the song)
LIFT out of the light verse bars into chorus 3 (+3.5 dB); contiguous to the end of the song
end card: the last chorus, straight into the final chord
ADD-1 (end card +1 bar): the final chord; it rings into the tail = the natural end of the song

title_stop.note: no stop in the song: the title sits on the final chord (GP 101) and its decay; the groove ends on 5:1 instead of a silence before it

pain_sparse.note: the song never drops its drums; the pain uses the lightest verse (about 3 dB under the chorus)

drop.note: +2.5 dB fill bar out of the light verse

payoff.note: the band stops on 49:1 (the final chord rings out under the wait) and slams back into chorus 2 on 51:1

break.note: no stop-time break in the song; two light verse bars

end_resolve.note: the song's own final chord on 90+1:1 and its decay
